tool_input.description: Probe createNumber behavior for various inputs

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtilsAgentTest.java` with 49 self-contained JUnit 5 test methods covering `NumberUtils`: constants, all `compare`/`createXxx`/`toXxx`/`toScaledBigDecimal` overloads, `createNumber` edge cases (hex, octal, type suffixes, BigInteger overflow, malformed input), `isCreatable`/`isDigits`/`isNumber`/`isParsable`, and every `max`/`min` variant including null-array and empty-array error cases. All tests compile under `--release 8` with no lambdas/diamond operators, and the full `./_tools/test.sh` run passes (49/49).
